subject.title: feat(ui): microphone picker on the composer talk button

question: Should the Control UI composer expose the existing realtime Talk microphone selection as a compact secondary control beside the Talk button?
rationale: The patch adds a persistent user-facing interaction surface; the protected `maintainer` label requires an explicit human decision even though the implementation intentionally reuses existing state and discovery paths.

options.title: Approve the composer picker
options.body: Accept microphone selection at the point of use while retaining Settings as the full Talk configuration surface.

options.title: Keep selection in Settings only
options.body: Decline the additional composer control and preserve the current single-surface configuration model.

recommendation.title: Approve the composer picker
recommendation.body: Accept microphone selection at the point of use while retaining Settings as the full Talk configuration surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR series is the available concrete ownership signal for the Talk composer interaction.
